definition: An open-domain question-answering dataset of real search queries, used in this archive as a retrieval-QA workload rather than as a reasoning benchmark. One source pairs it with HotpotQA as the two query sets for measuring per-query latency and energy in edge RAG; another places it with CRAG on the out-of-distribution side of a split whose in-distribution half is HotpotQA and HaluEval. Its single-hop character against HotpotQA's multi-hop one is what both uses rely on.

evidence.note: CoSMo restructures reasoning chains by merging redundant segments and splitting logical gaps, then trains with RL against a segment-count budget rather than a token budget.
evidence.title: Short Chains, Deep Thoughts: Balancing Reasoning Efficiency and Intra-Segment Capability via Split-Merge Optimization

name: Natural Questions
